product.title: Masque de someil Bluetooth 3D — Dors Mieux Dès Ce Soir

params.prompt: Cinematic 3D product showcase in the style of a PlayStation console reveal video: a single seamless 360-degree turntable rotation of the product. The hero product is the EXACT sleep mask from the reference image: a black 3D contoured Bluetooth sleep mask with a small control pad with three glowing blue buttons on the front left side — keep its shape, fabric texture and details perfectly faithful to the reference. The back of the product is a wide adjustable black elastic strap, similar to the strap visible in the reference but slightly wider, plain black fabric, no electronics on the back. Scene: minimalist pitch-black studio, subtle reflective floor, faint volumetric haze. The mask floats in mid-air, perfectly centered, slowly rotating on its vertical axis through a full smooth 360-degree turn so every side is shown — front, side profile, back strap, other side, returning to front. Camera locked and steady, very slight slow push-in. Deep blue and violet rim lights trace the contours as it turns, edge glints, tiny luminous dust particles drifting. Nighttime brand palette: midnight blue, violet, discreet gold accent. Elegant minimal on-screen text near the end: 'NOCTURNA' with tagline 'Dors mieux dès ce soir', then a final end card on black background with glowing text '-20% · CODE : NOCTURNA20'. Premium cinematic quality, constant slow rotation speed, fluid motion only, no jerky movement, shallow depth of field, high contrast, epic minimal sound design with a soft rising pad and a deep bass impact when the rotation completes.
